ops.quote: to generate synthetic anomaly images and reference masks for normal data
the proposed method uses hard augmentation to change the normal sample distribution
the coordinate channel, which represents the pixel location information, is concatenated to an input of AnoSeg
self-supervised learning with pixel-wise and adversarial losses
the proposed AnoSseg is trained in a self-supervised learning manner from the synthetic anomaly data and normal data
the estimated anomaly map can also be utilized to improve the performance of anomaly detection
we compared the proposed method with the existing methods through the intersection over union (IoU) metric
demonstrated the superiority of our method for anomaly segmentation
